note: Three `responsiveTsx` merges that drew something other than the widths, found by the new merge contract. A layout prop set at a narrow width, dropped at a middle one and set again wider is now cleared at the middle width; the single `"initial"` after the last value kept the narrow value there, which hid a layer only the tablet draws at every width. Siblings that share a name keep their own places in the order, so a title stays between its two quote marks instead of following both. A node drawn as different layout elements at different widths (a `VStack` at mobile, a `Box` at desktop) has what each element does by itself written out (`flexDir`, centring, `display`), so the first width's element no longer stacks the others.
